note: Which direction of each metric is bad. A metric nobody can defend does not belong here; a metric without a policy is not judged at all.

gate_dims.why: a dimension that quietly disappears is a claim nobody checks any more

regression_cases.why: these are the gate's own falsifications: fewer cases means less proof that it can fail

python_lines.why: code that grows faster than the proof grows is how a gate becomes a wish

largest_file_lines.why: one file becoming the place where everything lives is a refactor waiting to happen

python_files.why: file count is not quality, but a jump means a new surface nobody has tested

todo_markers.why: deferred work has a way of becoming permanent; three more is a warning, ten is a habit
